name: good-donkey
description: A 40px, 10px-radius message bar with a plus-circle attach control, a 200px field, and a paper-plane send mark.
purpose: Gives chat and comment rows the compact composer shape from the source inspo, mapped onto semantic tokens.

avoidFor: long-form editors that need a toolbar
